title: The Infinite Hive Where Cells Learn Their Own Genealogy

features.name: genealogy axis
features.desc-on-touch: A tower that points both up and down at once. Every cell knows where it came from and where it is learning to go.

features.name: hexagon sermon
features.desc-on-touch: A glyph of interlocking six-sides. The sacred geometry speaks: every cell is holy, and holiness lives in the fit between them.

features.name: cellular strata
features.desc-on-touch: Layers of history stacked: ancestors below, descendants reaching up. The whole hive is a conversation across generations.

features.name: inheritance arch
features.desc-on-touch: A doorway shaped like a genetic sequence. Every arch leads back to where the colony learned what it would become.

features.name: sacred dance-floor
features.desc-on-touch: Where the hive's knowledge lives in motion. The genealogy is not a tree; it is a pattern the colony performs.

reverie.title: REVERIE — where the hive dreams its own shape
narr: You are both kneeling in hexagonal light, and she is
pointing at how the cells fit together, no gaps, no waste.
She says: look how they know their own place. They are never
lost. You ask: were they taught? She is quiet, then: they
were born knowing. The colony is teaching them what they
already are. You both understand: that is what sacred means.

inscription: here the hive learns that geometry is not imposed by god but discovered between all the cells who dream together
